cards.name: hero
cards.title: Is TikTok getting banned? **No.**
cards.sub: The US ban was never enforced, and the sale the law required closed on 22 January 2026.

cards.name: why
cards.title: The law asked for **a sale, not a ban**

steps.title: The law
steps.text: Sell the US business, or face a ban.

steps.title: The result
steps.text: No ban date at the time of writing.

steps.title: Jan 2025
steps.text: Upheld; dark for about a day.

cards.name: bottom-line
cards.quote: TikTok isn’t going anywhere in the US. **Your audience still shouldn’t live in one app.**
cards.by: Keep your files, post your best videos elsewhere too, and check the date on any ban rumor.
